Signal Tower

Introduction

The signaltower class is used to change lights and detect interactions with the CTE Signal Tower.

Class Constructors

signaltower( 
  int32_t  index );

Class Destructor

Destroys the signaltower object and releases associated resources.

virtual ~signaltower();

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
index int32_t The Smart Port that the Signal Tower is connected to, written as PORTx, where x is the port number (for example, PORT1).

Examples

// Create a signal tower instance in Port 1
signaltower SignalTower = signaltower(PORT1);

Member Functions

The signaltower class provides the following member functions:

  • setColor - Controls the LED colors and states on the Signal Tower using various input methods.
  • setColors - Sets the state of all LEDs on the Signal Tower individually.
  • setBlink - Sets the blink state of an LED on the Signal Tower by the LED's ID.
  • setBlinkTime - Sets the time between blinks for the LEDs on the Signal Tower.
  • enableBlink - Enables blinking for multiple LEDs on the Signal Tower by their IDs.
  • disableBlink - Disables blinking for multiple LEDs on the Signal Tower by their IDs.
  • pressing - Returns whether the Signal Tower bumper is currently being pressed.
  • pressed - Registers a function to be called when the Signal Tower bumper is pressed.
  • released - Registers a function to be called when the Signal Tower bumper is released.

setColor

Controls the LED colors and states on the Signal Tower using various input methods. These lights can be used to track where the robot is at in a project or to show when certain conditions are met.

Available Functions

1 — Sets the Signal Tower to a color using vex::color.

void setColor( 
  vex::color         color, 
  signaltower::state state = signaltower::state::on );

2 — Sets LED colors using 32-bit RGB and YW values.

void setColor( 
  uint32_t rgb, 
  uint32_t yw );

3 — Sets individual LED brightness by LED ID.

void setColor( 
  ledId id, 
  uint32_t value );

4 — Sets brightness levels for all LEDs individually.

void setColor( 
  uint8_t r, 
  uint8_t y, 
  uint8_t g, 
  uint8_t b, 
  uint8_t w );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
color vex::color The color to use:
  • red
  • yellow
  • green
  • blue
  • white
  • all
    state signaltower::state The state for the LED:
    • on (Default) – Turns the LED on.
    • off – Turns the LED off.
    • blink – Makes the LED blink.
    rgb uint32_t The brightness of red, green and blue LED using a 32-bit value (e.g., red on = 0xFF0000, green on = 0x00FF00, and blue on = 0x0000FF).
    yw uint32_t The brightness of yellow and white LED using a 32-bit value (e.g., yellow on = 0xFF00 and white on = 0x00FF).
    id ledId The index of the LED to control:
    • 0 – red
    • 1 – green
    • 2 – blue
    • 3 – white
    • 4 – yellow
      value uint32_t The brightness of the LED from 0 to 255, with 0 being off and 255 being the max brightness.
      r uint8_t The brightness of the red LED from 0 to 255, with 0 being off and 255 being the max brightness.
      y uint8_t The brightness of the yellow LED from 0 to 255, with 0 being off and 255 being the max brightness.
      g uint8_t The brightness of the green LED from 0 to 255, with 0 being off and 255 being the max brightness.
      b uint8_t The brightness of the blue LED from 0 to 255, with 0 being off and 255 being the max brightness.
      w uint8_t The brightness of the white LED from 0 to 255, with 0 being off and 255 being the max brightness.

      Return Values

      This function does not return a value.

      Examples

      // Set the Signal Tower to start blinking blue
SignalTower.setColor(vex::color::blue, signaltower::blink);

// Set the red, blue and white LEDs using hex values
SignalTower.setColor(0xFF00FF, 0x00FF);

// Set the green LED to full brightness by ID
SignalTower.setColor(1, 255);

// Set all LEDs to full brightness
SignalTower.setColor(255, 255, 255, 255, 255);

      setColors

      Sets the state of all LEDs on the Signal Tower individually. These lights can be used to track where the robot is at in a project or to show when certain conditions are met.

      Available Functions

      void setColors( 
  signaltower::state rs, 
  signaltower::state ys, 
  signaltower::state gs, 
  signaltower::state bs, 
  signaltower::state ws );

      Parameters

      Parameter Type Description
      rs signaltower::state The state of the red LED:
      • on – Turns the LED on.
      • off – Turns the LED off.
      • blink – Makes the LED blink.
      ys signaltower::state The state of the yellow LED:
      • on – Turns the LED on.
      • off – Turns the LED off.
      • blink – Makes the LED blink.
      gs signaltower::state The state of the green LED:
      • on – Turns the LED on.
      • off – Turns the LED off.
      • blink – Makes the LED blink.
      bs signaltower::state The state of the blue LED:
      • on – Turns the LED on.
      • off – Turns the LED off.
      • blink – Makes the LED blink.
      ws signaltower::state The state of the white LED:
      • on – Turns the LED on.
      • off – Turns the LED off.
      • blink – Makes the LED blink.

      Return Values

      This function does not return a value.

      Examples

      // Turn on all LEDs
SignalTower.setColors(signaltower::on, signaltower::on, signaltower::on, signaltower::on, signaltower::on);

      setBlink

      Sets the blink state of an LED on the Signal Tower by the LED's ID. These blinking lights can be used to show when certain conditions are met, such as when the robot is waiting or when attention is needed.

      Available Functions

      void setBlink( 
  ledId id, 
  bool  enable );

      Parameters

      Parameter Type Description
      id ledId The LED ID:
      • 0 – red
      • 1 – green
      • 2 – blue
      • 3 – white
      • 4 – yellow
      • 99 – none
      enable bool
      • true – Enables blinking.
      • false – Disables blinking.

      Return Values

      This function does not return a value.

      setBlinkTime

      Sets the time between blinks for the LEDs on the Signal Tower.

      Available Functions

      void setBlinkTime( 
  uint32_t onTime, 
  uint32_t offTime = 0 );

      Parameters

      Parameter Type Description
      onTime uint32_t The time in milliseconds that the LED should be on when blinking. Max is 2500ms. A value of 0 defaults to 500ms.
      offTime uint32_t The time in milliseconds that the LED should be off when blinking. Max is 2500ms. A value of 0 uses the onTime value. Default is 0.

      Return Values

      This function does not return a value.

      enableBlink

      Enables blinking for multiple LEDs on the Signal Tower by their IDs.

      Available Functions

      void enableBlink( 
  ledId id0, 
  ledId id1 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id2 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id3 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id4 = ledId::none );

      Parameters

      Parameter Type Description
      id0 ledId The LED ID:
      • 0 – red
      • 1 – green
      • 2 – blue
      • 3 – white
      • 4 – yellow
      • 99 – none
      id1 ledId The index of the second LED (optional). Default is ledId::none.
      • 0 – red
      • 1 – green
      • 2 – blue
      • 3 – white
      • 4 – yellow
      • 99 – none
      id2 ledId The index of the third LED (optional). Default is ledId::none.
      • 0 – red
      • 1 – green
      • 2 – blue
      • 3 – white
      • 4 – yellow
      • 99 – none
      id3 ledId The index of the fourth LED (optional). Default is ledId::none.
      • 0 – red
      • 1 – green
      • 2 – blue
      • 3 – white
      • 4 – yellow
      • 99 – none
      id4 ledId The index of the fifth LED (optional). Default is ledId::none.
      • 0 – red
      • 1 – green
      • 2 – blue
      • 3 – white
      • 4 – yellow
      • 99 – none

      Return Values

      This function does not return a value.

      disableBlink

      Disables blinking for multiple LEDs on the Signal Tower by their IDs.

      Available Functions

      void disableBlink( 
  ledId id0, 
  ledId id1 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id2 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id3 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id4 = ledId::none );

      Parameters

      Parameter Type Description
      id0 ledId The index of the first LED.
      • 0 – red
      • 1 – green
      • 2 – blue
      • 3 – white
      • 4 – yellow
      • 99 – none
      id1 ledId The index of the second LED (optional). Default is ledId::none.
      • 0 – red
      • 1 – green
      • 2 – blue
      • 3 – white
      • 4 – yellow
      • 99 – none
      id2 ledId The index of the third LED (optional). Default is ledId::none.
      • 0 – red
      • 1 – green
      • 2 – blue
      • 3 – white
      • 4 – yellow
      • 99 – none
      id3 ledId The index of the fourth LED (optional). Default is ledId::none.
      • 0 – red
      • 1 – green
      • 2 – blue
      • 3 – white
      • 4 – yellow
      • 99 – none
      id4 ledId The index of the fifth LED (optional). Default is ledId::none.
      • 0 – red
      • 1 – green
      • 2 – blue
      • 3 – white
      • 4 – yellow
      • 99 – none

      Return Values

      This function does not return a value.

      pressing

      Returns whether the Signal Tower's bumper is currently being pressed. This can be used as an emergency stop.

      Available Functions

      bool pressing();

      Parameters

      This function does not have parameters.

      Return Values

      Returns a Boolean indicating whether the Signal Tower's bumper is currently being pressed.

      • true — The Signal Tower's bumper is currently being pressed.
      • false — The Signal Tower's bumper is not being pressed.

      pressed

      Registers a function to be called when the Signal Tower bumper is pressed.

      Available Functions

      void pressed( void (* callback)(void) );

      Parameters

      Parameter Type Description
      callback void (*)(void) A pointer to a function that will be called when the bumper is pressed.

      Return Values

      This function does not return a value.

      Examples

      Define the callback function (outside of int main())

      // Display a message when bumper is pressed
void towerBumperPressed() {
  Brain.Screen.print("tower bumper pressed");
}

      Register the callback inside int main()

      int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run towerBumperPressed when the tower bumper 
  // is pressed
  SignalTower.pressed(towerBumperPressed);
}

      released

      Registers a function to be called when the Signal Tower bumper is released.

      Available Functions

      void released( void (* callback)(void) );

      Parameters

      Parameter Type Description
      callback void (*)(void) A pointer to a function that will be called when the bumper is released.

      Return Values

      This function does not return a value.

      Examples

      Define the callback function (outside of int main())

      // Display a message when bumper is released
void towerBumperReleased() {
  Brain.Screen.print("tower bumper released");
}

      Register the callback inside int main()

      int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run towerBumperReleased when the tower bumper 
  // is released
  SignalTower.released(towerBumperReleased);
}
zh:
信号灯塔

概述

signaltower类用于改变灯光并检测与 CTE 信号塔的交互。

构造函数

signaltower( 
  int32_t  index );

析构函数

销毁signaltower对象并释放关联资源。

virtual ~signaltower();

参数

参数 类型 说明
index int32_t 信号塔连接的智能端口，写作PORTx，其中x是端口号（例如PORT1）。

示例

// Create a signal tower instance in Port 1
signaltower SignalTower = signaltower(PORT1);

成员函数

signaltower类提供以下成员函数：

  • setColor- 使用各种输入方法控制信号塔上的 LED 颜色和状态。
  • setColors- 单独设置信号塔上所有 LED 的状态。
  • setBlink- 通过 LED 的 ID 设置信号塔上 LED 的闪烁状态。
  • setBlinkTime- 设置信号塔上 LED 闪烁的时间间隔。
  • enableBlink- 启用信号塔上多个 LED 的 ID 闪烁。
  • disableBlink- 通过 ID 禁用信号塔上多个 LED 的闪烁。
  • 按下- 返回信号塔保险杠当前是否被按下。
  • 按下- 注册一个在按下信号塔缓冲器时调用的函数。
  • 已发布- 注册信号塔缓冲器释放时要调用的函数。

setColor

使用各种输入方法控制信号塔上的 LED 颜色和状态。这些灯可用于跟踪机器人在项目中的位置或显示何时满足某些条件。

函数重载

1—使用 vex::color 将信号塔设置为颜色。

void setColor( 
  vex::color         color, 
  signaltower::state state = signaltower::state::on );

2—使用 32 位 RGB 和 YW 值设置 LED 颜色。

void setColor( 
  uint32_t rgb, 
  uint32_t yw );

3—通过 LED ID 设置各个 LED 亮度。

void setColor( 
  ledId id, 
  uint32_t value );

4—单独设置所有 LED 的亮度级别。

void setColor( 
  uint8_t r, 
  uint8_t y, 
  uint8_t g, 
  uint8_t b, 
  uint8_t w );

参数

参数 类型 说明
color vex::color 使用的颜色：
  • red
  • yellow
  • green
  • blue
  • white
  • all
    state signaltower::state LED 的状态：
    • on（默认） – 打开 LED。
    • off– 关闭 LED。
    • blink– 使 LED 闪烁。
    rgb uint32_t 使用 32 位值的红色、绿色和蓝色 LED 的亮度（例如，红色亮起 =0xFF0000，绿色亮起 =0x00FF00，蓝色亮起 =0x0000FF）。
    yw uint32_t 使用 32 位值的黄色和白色 LED 的亮度（例如，黄色亮 =0xFF00，白色亮 =0x00FF）。
    id ledId 控制 LED 的索引：
    • 0– 红色
    • 1– 绿色
    • 2– 蓝色
    • 3– 白色
    • 4– 黄色
      value uint32_t LED 的亮度从 0 到 255，其中 0 为关闭，255 为最大亮度。
      r uint8_t 红色LED的亮度从0到255，0为关闭，255为最大亮度。
      y uint8_t 黄色 LED 的亮度从 0 到 255，其中 0 为关闭，255 为最大亮度。
      g uint8_t 绿色 LED 的亮度从 0 到 255，其中 0 为关闭，255 为最大亮度。
      b uint8_t 蓝色 LED 的亮度从 0 到 255，其中 0 为关闭，255 为最大亮度。
      w uint8_t 白光 LED 的亮度范围为 0 至 255，其中 0 为关闭，255 为最大亮度。

      返回值

      此函数无返回值。

      示例

      // Set the Signal Tower to start blinking blue
SignalTower.setColor(vex::color::blue, signaltower::blink);

// Set the red, blue and white LEDs using hex values
SignalTower.setColor(0xFF00FF, 0x00FF);

// Set the green LED to full brightness by ID
SignalTower.setColor(1, 255);

// Set all LEDs to full brightness
SignalTower.setColor(255, 255, 255, 255, 255);

      setColors

      单独设置信号塔上所有 LED 的状态。这些灯可用于跟踪机器人在项目中的位置或显示何时满足某些条件。

      函数重载

      void setColors( 
  signaltower::state rs, 
  signaltower::state ys, 
  signaltower::state gs, 
  signaltower::state bs, 
  signaltower::state ws );

      参数

      参数 类型 说明
      rs signaltower::state 红色 LED 的状态：
      • on– 打开 LED。
      • off– 关闭 LED。
      • blink– 使 LED 闪烁。
      ys signaltower::state 黄色 LED 的状态：
      • on– 打开 LED。
      • off– 关闭 LED。
      • blink– 使 LED 闪烁。
      gs signaltower::state 绿色 LED 的状态：
      • on– 打开 LED。
      • off– 关闭 LED。
      • blink– 使 LED 闪烁。
      bs signaltower::state 蓝色 LED 的状态：
      • on– 打开 LED。
      • off– 关闭 LED。
      • blink– 使 LED 闪烁。
      ws signaltower::state 白色 LED 的状态：
      • on– 打开 LED。
      • off– 关闭 LED。
      • blink– 使 LED 闪烁。

      返回值

      此函数无返回值。

      示例

      // Turn on all LEDs
SignalTower.setColors(signaltower::on, signaltower::on, signaltower::on, signaltower::on, signaltower::on);

      setBlink

      通过 LED 的 ID 设置信号塔上 LED 的闪烁状态。这些闪烁的灯可用于显示何时满足某些条件，例如机器人何时等待或何时需要注意。

      函数重载

      void setBlink( 
  ledId id, 
  bool  enable );

      参数

      参数 类型 说明
      id ledId LED ID：
      • 0– 红色
      • 1– 绿色
      • 2– 蓝色
      • 3– 白色
      • 4– 黄色
      • 99– 无
      enable bool
      • true– 启用闪烁。
      • false– 禁用闪烁。

      返回值

      此函数无返回值。

      setBlinkTime

      设置信号塔上 LED 闪烁的时间间隔。

      函数重载

      void setBlinkTime( 
  uint32_t onTime, 
  uint32_t offTime = 0 );

      参数

      参数 类型 说明
      onTime uint32_t LED 闪烁时应亮起的时间（以毫秒为单位）。最大值为 2500 毫秒。值 0 默认为 500 毫秒。
      offTime uint32_t LED 闪烁时应关闭的时间（以毫秒为单位）。最大值为 2500 毫秒。值 0 使用 onTime 值。默认值为 0。

      返回值

      此函数无返回值。

      enableBlink

      启用信号塔上多个 LED 的 ID 闪烁。

      函数重载

      void enableBlink( 
  ledId id0, 
  ledId id1 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id2 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id3 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id4 = ledId::none );

      参数

      参数 类型 说明
      id0 ledId LED ID：
      • 0– 红色
      • 1– 绿色
      • 2– 蓝色
      • 3– 白色
      • 4– 黄色
      • 99– 无
      id1 ledId 第二个 LED 的索引（可选）。默认为ledId::none。
      • 0– 红色
      • 1– 绿色
      • 2– 蓝色
      • 3– 白色
      • 4– 黄色
      • 99– 无
      id2 ledId 第三个 LED 的索引（可选）。默认为ledId::none。
      • 0– 红色
      • 1– 绿色
      • 2– 蓝色
      • 3– 白色
      • 4– 黄色
      • 99– 无
      id3 ledId 第四个 LED 的索引（可选）。默认为ledId::none。
      • 0– 红色
      • 1– 绿色
      • 2– 蓝色
      • 3– 白色
      • 4– 黄色
      • 99– 无
      id4 ledId 第五个 LED 的索引（可选）。默认为ledId::none。
      • 0– 红色
      • 1– 绿色
      • 2– 蓝色
      • 3– 白色
      • 4– 黄色
      • 99– 无

      返回值

      此函数无返回值。

      disableBlink

      通过 ID 禁用信号塔上多个 LED 的闪烁。

      函数重载

      void disableBlink( 
  ledId id0, 
  ledId id1 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id2 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id3 = ledId::none, 
  ledId id4 = ledId::none );

      参数

      参数 类型 说明
      id0 ledId 第一个 LED 的索引。
      • 0– 红色
      • 1– 绿色
      • 2– 蓝色
      • 3– 白色
      • 4– 黄色
      • 99– 无
      id1 ledId 第二个 LED 的索引（可选）。默认为ledId::none。
      • 0– 红色
      • 1– 绿色
      • 2– 蓝色
      • 3– 白色
      • 4– 黄色
      • 99– 无
      id2 ledId 第三个 LED 的索引（可选）。默认为ledId::none。
      • 0– 红色
      • 1– 绿色
      • 2– 蓝色
      • 3– 白色
      • 4– 黄色
      • 99– 无
      id3 ledId 第四个 LED 的索引（可选）。默认为ledId::none。
      • 0– 红色
      • 1– 绿色
      • 2– 蓝色
      • 3– 白色
      • 4– 黄色
      • 99– 无
      id4 ledId 第五个 LED 的索引（可选）。默认为ledId::none。
      • 0– 红色
      • 1– 绿色
      • 2– 蓝色
      • 3– 白色
      • 4– 黄色
      • 99– 无

      返回值

      此函数无返回值。

      pressing

      返回信号塔的保险杠当前是否被按下。这可以用作紧急停止。

      函数重载

      bool pressing();

      参数

      该函数没有参数。

      返回值

      返回一个布尔值，指示信号塔的保险杠当前是否被按下。

      • true— 信号塔的保险杠当前正在被按下。
      • false— 信号塔的保险杠没有被按下。

      pressed

      注册一个在按下信号塔保险杠时调用的函数。

      函数重载

      void pressed( void (* callback)(void) );

      参数

      参数 类型 说明
      callback void (*)(void) 指向按下保险杠时将调用的函数的指针。

      返回值

      此函数无返回值。

      示例

      定义回调函数（在int main()之外）

      // Display a message when bumper is pressed
void towerBumperPressed() {
  Brain.Screen.print("tower bumper pressed");
}

      在int main()内部注册回调函数

      int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run towerBumperPressed when the tower bumper 
  // is pressed
  SignalTower.pressed(towerBumperPressed);
}

      released

      注册一个在信号塔缓冲器释放时调用的函数。

      函数重载

      void released( void (* callback)(void) );

      参数

      参数 类型 说明
      callback void (*)(void) 指向释放保险杠时将调用的函数的指针。

      返回值

      此函数无返回值。

      示例

      定义回调函数（在int main()之外）

      // Display a message when bumper is released
void towerBumperReleased() {
  Brain.Screen.print("tower bumper released");
}

      在int main()内部注册回调函数

      int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run towerBumperReleased when the tower bumper 
  // is released
  SignalTower.released(towerBumperReleased);
}
